claims.statement: Tom Allen was still in the Market Street block between Sixth and Seventh streets, St. Louis, which was about to be torn down.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen is in the same place yet, but it will not be long
places: Market Street block between Sixth and Seventh streets, St. Louis

claims.statement: Mike McCool, Tom Kelley and Tom Allen used to meet in the Market Street block between Sixth and Seventh streets to congregate and arrange their matches.
claims.excerpt: and Tom Allen and their following of the fistic fraternity used to congregate
places: Market Street block between Sixth and Seventh streets, St. Louis

notes: The text does not say Allen ran the block's drinking place; the 'saloon' kind is from the hint and the block's use as a haunt. The rest of the page (old buildings, Greek murder case, rail fares) is not about Allen.
